name: arcade-player1-armored-task51
prompt: A full-body depiction of a slender gunslinger hero clad in a fusion of classic Western attire and ornate gothic plate armor. He wears a wide-brimmed brown cowboy hat atop an exposed, resolute face. Over a crisp white shirt and black vest, he dons a polished steel breastplate adorned with intricate, dark engraved filigree, paired with rounded, riveted pauldrons. A vivid crimson cloth tabard with shimmering gold trim drapes across his torso, contrasting with his dark trousers and heavy leather boots. Steel gauntlets and greaves provide protection, while a vintage revolver rests in a worn leather holster at his hip. The figure is rendered with high-contrast shading to accentuate the metallic sheen of the steel, featuring crisp, selective outlines for clarity and subtle rim lighting to define his silhouette against the low top-down perspective.
